beauty_1.name: Beauty
dialog: I came a very long way to be here. Two ships, and a road full of trainers who would not let me by!
It was worth every step. I may never go home.

beauty_2.name: Beauty
dialog: Nothing is too good for my Pokémon. The softest beds, the finest Poffins, a view of the water...
They have earned a holiday. So have I, for carrying all their luggage.

black_belt.name: Black Belt
dialog: All these people lying about in the sun! Do they know what's under their feet?
Go down into the Underground and you can dig up all sorts of wonderful things. Now that's a holiday!

ace_trainer_f.name: Ace Trainer
dialog: The Ribbon Syndicate! Only the very finest people, with the very finest Pokémon, are let through its doors.
Oh, how I long to be a member. Ten Ribbons on one Pokémon, they say, and I have... three.

swimmer_m.name: Swimmer
dialog: I've swum every stretch of water at the resort, and I'd swear something lurks at the bottom of that pond.
Something big, that never comes up. A fisherman with a good enough rod might find out what.

signs.map_signpost:
Resort Area
A place of rest for trainers and their Pokémon.
